not_found: Isotope shifts of 811.5 nm between the even isotopes (78, 80, 82, 84, 86) and for 81Kr / 85Kr: reported by Cannon & Janik (Phys. Rev. A 42, 397 (1990)) and Cannon (Phys. Rev. A 47, 1148 (1993)), but only the abstracts (no numbers) could be opened; only Delta nu(78,83) from Williams et al. is recorded.
Hyperfine A, B constants of 81Kr and 85Kr in 5s[3/2]2 and 5p[5/2]3 (Cannon 1993): abstract only, no numbers.
Absolute optical frequencies of 811.5 / 810.4 / 819 nm better than NIST: not located.

Measured Lande g factors of the 5s and 5p levels (NIST ASD lists none for Kr): Sears & McKellar (Can. J. Phys. 60, 345 (1982), laser magnetic resonance of metastable Kr and Xe) was identified but could not be opened.
Experimental reduced matrix elements: none located.

Isotope shifts of 811.5 nm between all even isotopes and hyperfine A, B of 81Kr / 85Kr in 5s[3/2]2 and 5p[5/2]3 (Cannon & Janik 1990, Cannon 1993): still not opened; only the 5p[3/2]2 constants are available second-hand.
810.4 nm line 5s[3/2]2-5p[5/2]2: A value and branching now stored (Dzierzega et al.), 83Kr A, B of the upper level stored; no precise frequency or isotope shift located.
Lifetimes of the 5s resonance levels, 6s, 4d, 5d, 6p, 7s, 7p ... levels drawn: none located in an open source (OSTI record 429785 on 6p lifetimes not opened).
Measured lifetime of the metastable 5s'[1/2]0: none located; theory 0.488 s stored.
Xenon/krypton TALIF review (Eur. Phys. J. Techn. Instrum. 2022, s40485-022-00077-y) is open access but behind a bot wall; not opened.
conflicts: 3P2 (5s[3/2]2) lifetime: Lefers et al. 2002 28.3(1.8) s (absolute VUV M2 rate, 84Kr) vs Katori & Shimizu 1993 39 (+5/-4) s (MOT fluorescence decay); theory 63-85 s. The more recent, directly normalised Lefers value is used; Ding et al. and other ATTA papers quote '40 s'.

5p'[3/2]2 (2p2, the TALIF level) lifetime: TALIF measurements give 34.6(2.3) ns (Gazeli 2020), 34.1 ns (Niemi 2001), 35.4(2.7), 33.6(1.1) ns, whereas Dzierzega et al. 2000 list 26.9(0.3) ns (pulsed laser, Chang et al.), a best experimental estimate 29.5(2.4) ns and a semi-empirical 28.59(7) ns, which they used for the A values of the three 2p2 lines. The direct recent TALIF value is the main entry; the A values of the 2p2 lines therefore rest on a lifetime about 20 % shorter.

Branching of 5p[3/2]2 to the metastable 5s[3/2]2 (760 nm): measured 0.751(8) / 0.743(7) (Dzierzega 2000) and 0.75(4) (Dakka 2018); the existing entry 'branching_upper_to_metastable' = 0.90 on the 819 nm line (stated without origin by Ding et al. 2007) is contradicted by these measurements and should not be used.
5p[5/2]3 (2p9) lifetime: main entry changed from the Vassen-review 28.0 ns to the beam-gas-laser value 27.694(18) ns (second-hand via Dzierzega et al.); the review value is kept as an alternative.

2p1, 2p5, 2p10 lifetimes: experimental best estimates 24.6(2.0), 23.5(1.9), 40.9(3.3) ns vs semi-empirical 24.58(85), 23.12(85), 38.13(1.07) ns; the A values of Dzierzega et al. for lines from these levels use the semi-empirical lifetimes.
notes: Isotope-shift keys 'A-B' mean nu(A) - nu(B). 83Kr values are hyperfine centre of gravity. 81Kr and 85Kr are radioactive ATTA tracers; their nuclear spins were not confirmed in an opened source and are therefore omitted. Level energies are NIST ASD values from data/kr/levels.csv; Paschen names in the labels. Entries marked '(abstract)' were read on the publisher's abstract page only. Added 2026-10-01 (second pass): nuclear spins of 81Kr (7/2) and 85Kr (9/2, derived from listed F values) now given. All 30 5s-5p transition rates and branching fractions are from Dzierzega et al. 2000 (the source NIST uses); A values for lines from 2p1, 2p2, 2p5, 2p10 rest on semi-empirical lifetimes. Ground-state isotope shifts of Brandi et al. are printed as nu(84) - nu(A). The 86Kr level energies of Brandi et al. are from 2002 (older than 20 years). 819 nm shifts for 81, 83, 85 are calculated, not measured.
